note: A paper record of the desk's readings of the engulf on five markets, buys and sells: the engulf rule on D1, H4 and H1 candles, and three zone methods (the plan with the Daily, the short method in an H4 zone, the direct entry on fresh zones) with a 30-pip stop; the plan and the short method take the target the owner picked for each on the 2026 records (1R; the short method with the next-candle engulf 4R), the direct entry none: its stop is trailed with the 5-minute engulf zones that fail. The plan and the short method are recorded twice, apart: with the engulf completed within three candles, and with the next-candle engulf only. A fifth reading, apart: inside a 15-minute engulf zone, the most recent one-minute engulf of the other side fails and the entry is that close (the stop past the extreme made since, a 2R target: the desk's own choice). A sixth reading, apart, the three-timeframe SOP on three chains (Daily / H4 / H1, H4 / H1 / M15, H1 / M15 / M5): an engulf zone on the first timeframe, price back in it and an engulf at it on the second, an engulf at that one on the third, each completed within three candles; a limit at the middle of the last zone, the stop past the second timeframe's zone, a 2R target (the order's life and the exact target are the desk's own choice). A seventh reading, apart, from a gold example of 20-23 Nov 2026: an H4 engulf zone that failed (an H4 close through it) turns into a barrier the other way (an EF); price comes back into it, an M15 BO with it (a close beyond the last M15 A / V level and out of the zone), then a limit at the zone's near side, the stop past its far side, the target the near side of the nearest H4 engulf zone of the other side still standing, only when it is 2R or more away (the barrier's 20 days, the BO's window and the order's life are the desk's own choice). Nothing is traded, results are before costs, and none is a tested rule.
